column1: #mapping_set_description: 'Seqinfo object (Seqinfo package, formerly GenomeInfoDb) written as a table: the columns of as.data.frame(<Seqinfo>). One record per sequence. Seqinfo is an in-memory R object with no official file format; the adapter also reads the text that show(<Seqinfo>) prints.'

column9: Lossy: Per sequence in Seqinfo; a Seqinfo mixing genomes keeps the first and lists the rest in conflicts.
